Senses.Explanation: To open one’s mouth is the visible onset of speaking, repeatedly made the exact pressure point of a Chan exchange. In the Guizong case an unnamed monk is struck precisely when he is about to open his mouth; in Xuedou Chongxian’s meeting with Zhimen, the second blow falls at the same instant. Yuanwu stops Kaifu Daoning as soon as he begins, while Dahui threatens a hot iron wheel at the mere move. Other addresses demand that the assembly open its mouths or direct recognition to what precedes opening mouth and raising intention. Foyin’s portrait verse turns an open-mouthed smile into a public question. Zen bends an ordinary bodily transition into the timed boundary where an answer is demanded, interrupted, struck, or forestalled.
